setup.ariaLabel: How to set yourself up for the video interview
setup.correctAlt: Correct set-up: sitting on a sofa, shown from head to knees
setup.wrongAlt: Not this: sitting behind a table, shown from the waist up
setup.correctText: Do this: sit on a chair or sofa (or stand), camera shows you from head to knees, hands in view.
setup.wrongText: Not this: behind a desk or table, cut off at the waist. Notes or screens could be hidden.
